wrench_frame_and_origin: drone body frame, body origin; rotor wrench excludes gravity and externally applied torque
geometry: B0 allocator uses 0.035355 m XY offsets; physical XML sites use 0.03536 m; neither changed
time: policy pre-state / raw observation / action / xi_t, after current boundary event
time_post: post physical state and true-reference errors, before any event at the next boundary
motor_sample_time: last physics interval start, after advancing first-order rotor model and before applying force to engine
motor_thrust_unclipped: N, active allocator pseudoinverse result before clipping
baseline_unclipped_motor_command: N, B0 pseudoinverse times desired wrench, diagnostic only
allocator_unclipped_motor_command: N, active pseudoinverse times desired wrench
allocator_clipped_motor_command: N, rotor thrust commands clipped to existing allocator limits
motor_thrust_nominal: N, after actuator lag, before efficiency
motor_thrust_actual: N, after exactly one plant efficiency multiplication
allocation_residual_xml: desired wrench - B_xml @ (plant_eta * final clipped thrust commands)
actuator_response_residual_xml: static predicted rotor wrench - actual rotor wrench after lag
allocation_residual_b0: same static diagnostic using preserved allocator geometry, to distinguish tiny XML rounding discrepancy
limits: clipping and boundary dwell use every physics interval; integral freezes once per control interval if any constituent interval hits a boundary
event_recovery: right-limit event sample plus subsequent post states through next event left limit; 5mm/0.02m/s for >=1s through interval end
partial: unobserved fixed windows null; observed pre-termination metrics stored separately
